title: Construction of new Inspection quarter at Navabandar Lighthouse Station.
summary: Online item-percentage two-bid e-tender for construction of a new inspection quarter at Navabandar Lighthouse, Junagadh District, Gujarat, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar

sites.name: Navabandar Lighthouse, Post-Navabandar Village, Via-Delvada-362 510, Dist-Junagadh (Gujarat)

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST, as per item percentage BoQ. EMD by DD/FDR/Deposit at call receipt of scheduled (nationalized/RBI approved) bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar, valid 180 days from technical bid opening; original to be submitted by 07/08/2025. Firms registered with MSME must submit EMD; no exemption.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Appropriate category (Building Works) and class contractor
Similar works completed in central/state government department/undertaking in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; value updated at 7% p.a. simple
Similar works: civil construction or maintenance of any type of building or civil structure; supported by client certificates
Valid PAN and GST registration; valid registration of appropriate class and category (civil) with central/state government department/undertaking
Joint ventures and consortia not permitted
Declaration of not being blacklisted/debarred; undertaking that price bid is unconditional; tender acceptance letter
Bank solvency certificate of at least 40% of estimated cost, not older than 1 year
Average annual turnover of last three financial years (2021-22 to 2023-24) at least 30% of estimated cost, CA certified

unreadable: Hindi text layer garbled/missing; pages 1 and 4 rendered and read by vision to recover date and blanks

notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only, printed pages 3-7; no BOQ. Download period 24/07/2025 18:00 to 07/08/2025 15:00; financial bid opening to be intimated via CPP portal. Listing has no end date. Station match: Navabandar (via Delvada, near Diu) taken as Nawabander Lighthouse; Navibandar Lighthouse (Porbandar) is a different station.
